note: Placement items for a first, rough estimate (Pre-A1 to C2; B2–C2 added in Phase 5.2 and more items per level added later, always without changing earlier items, so past sessions stay valid). Difficulty 1–5 and discrimination 0–1 are authored estimates, to be recalibrated from real responses later.

items.prompt_en: apple
items.explanation_zh: apple = 苹果。

items.prompt_en: Thank you.
items.explanation_zh: Thank you = 谢谢。
猫 = cat。

items.prompt_en: book
items.explanation_zh: book = 书。
妈妈 = mother，口语里英式说 mum，美式说 mom。

items.prompt_en: kitchen
items.explanation_zh: kitchen = 厨房。

items.prompt_en: expensive
items.explanation_zh: expensive = 贵的；cheap = 便宜的。
早餐 = breakfast。

items.prompt_en: hungry
items.explanation_zh: hungry = 饿的；渴的是 thirsty，累的是 tired。
外套 = coat，短一点的外套也叫 jacket。

items.prompt_en: Can I borrow your pen?
items.prompt_zh: borrow 在这里是什么意思？
items.explanation_zh: borrow = 借入；lend = 借出。

items.prompt_en: journey
items.explanation_zh: journey = 旅程，尤其指从一地到另一地的过程。

items.sentence_en: Don't forget your ___ at the airport.
items.translation_zh: 在机场别忘了你的护照。
items.explanation_zh: 护照 = passport。

items.prompt_en: The shop is always crowded on Saturdays.
items.explanation_zh: crowded = 人很多的、拥挤的。

items.sentence_en: I'm going to ___ my old bike and buy a new one.
items.translation_zh: 我打算卖掉旧自行车，买一辆新的。
items.explanation_zh: 卖 = sell（过去式 sold）；买 = buy。

items.prompt_en: She's very reliable.
items.explanation_zh: reliable = 可靠的、靠得住的。

items.prompt_en: We can't afford a new car.
items.explanation_zh: can't afford = 买不起、负担不起。

items.prompt_zh: 用英文写出“建议”（名词，不可数）
items.explanation_zh: 建议（名词）= advice，不可数；动词是 advise。

items.prompt_en: The concert was cancelled due to bad weather.
items.explanation_zh: due to = because of，由于。

items.sentence_en: I'd like to ___ a complaint about the noise.
items.explanation_zh: make a complaint 最常用，正式场合也说 file / lodge a complaint。

items.prompt_en: The results of the study were inconclusive.
items.explanation_zh: inconclusive = 没有得出明确结论的。

items.prompt_en: She was reluctant to accept the offer.
items.explanation_zh: be reluctant to do = 不情愿做某事。

items.prompt_zh: 补全常见搭配：“做出决定”
items.sentence_en: We need to ___ a decision by Friday.
items.translation_zh: 我们需要在周五前做出决定。
items.explanation_zh: make a decision 最常用，也可以说 reach / take a decision；不说 do a decision。

items.prompt_en: The plan is feasible, but it will be expensive.
items.explanation_zh: feasible = 能做到的、可行的。

items.sentence_en: Despite the setback, she managed to ___ her goal.
items.translation_zh: 尽管受挫，她还是实现了目标。
items.explanation_zh: achieve / reach / meet a goal 都很常见；attain 更正式。

items.prompt_en: The minister's remarks were deliberately ambiguous.
items.explanation_zh: ambiguous = 有多种理解、模棱两可的。

items.prompt_en: His argument doesn't hold water.
items.prompt_zh: doesn't hold water 的意思是：
items.explanation_zh: hold water（论点）站得住脚；doesn't hold water = 经不起推敲。

items.prompt_zh: 补全搭配：“产生深远的影响”
items.sentence_en: The new policy has had a profound ___ on small businesses.
items.translation_zh: 新政策对小企业产生了深远的影响。
items.explanation_zh: have a profound impact / effect on ... = 对……产生深远影响。

items.prompt_en: The report glosses over the risks.
items.explanation_zh: gloss over = 一笔带过，故意不深谈不利的方面。

items.prompt_zh: 补全固定说法：“引起共鸣”
items.sentence_en: Her speech struck a ___ with many young voters.
items.translation_zh: 她的演讲引起了很多年轻选民的共鸣。
items.explanation_zh: strike a chord (with sb) = 引起（某人的）共鸣。

items.prompt_en: It was a rather backhanded compliment.
options: 表面称赞、实则贬低的话
items.explanation_zh: backhanded compliment = 明褒暗贬的话。

items.prompt_en: The committee's decision was a foregone conclusion.
items.prompt_zh: a foregone conclusion 的意思是：
items.explanation_zh: a foregone conclusion = 不出所料、早已注定的结果。

items.prompt_zh: 补全固定说法：“互相排斥的”
items.sentence_en: The two proposals are not mutually ___; we could adopt both.
items.translation_zh: 这两个提案并不互相排斥，我们可以都采纳。
items.explanation_zh: mutually exclusive = 互相排斥、不能同时成立的。

items.prompt_en: His apology seemed somewhat perfunctory.
items.explanation_zh: perfunctory = 走过场的、敷衍的。

items.prompt_zh: 补全固定说法：“充分证明了……”
items.sentence_en: The company's success is a ___ to the team's hard work.
items.translation_zh: 公司的成功充分证明了团队的努力。
items.explanation_zh: be a testament to sth = 是……的明证。

items.prompt_en: I ___ a student.
items.explanation_zh: I 用 am。

items.prompt_en: This is ___ apple.
items.explanation_zh: apple 以元音音开头，用 an。

items.prompt_en: She ___ my sister.
items.explanation_zh: she 用 is。

items.prompt_en: They ___ my friends.
items.explanation_zh: they 用 are。

items.prompt_en: I have two ___.
items.explanation_zh: two 后面用复数：books。

items.prompt_en: He ___ to work by bus every day.
items.explanation_zh: 一般现在时，第三人称单数 he 后动词加 -es：goes。

items.prompt_en: ___ you like coffee?
items.explanation_zh: like 是普通动词，问句用 Do。

items.prompt_en: There ___ two cats in the garden.
items.explanation_zh: two cats 是复数：There are。

items.prompt_en: She ___ like fish.
items.explanation_zh: she 是第三人称单数，一般现在时的否定用 doesn't + 动词原形。
现在进行时：are + 动词-ing；children 是复数，用 are。

items.prompt_en: I ___ to Beijing last year.
items.explanation_zh: last year 是过去的时间，用一般过去时 went。

items.prompt_en: She is ___ than her brother.
items.explanation_zh: than 前面用比较级 taller。

items.sentence_en: I'm going ___ visit my grandma tomorrow.
items.explanation_zh: be going to + 动词原形：表示计划。

items.prompt_en: We ___ TV when the phone rang.
items.explanation_zh: 过去进行时表示当时正在做的事，被另一个动作（电话响了）打断。

items.prompt_en: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
items.explanation_zh: milk 不可数，否定句里用 much（也可以说 any）。

items.prompt_en: I have lived here ___ 2019.
items.explanation_zh: 现在完成时 + since + 时间点。

items.prompt_en: If I ___ more time, I would travel more.
items.explanation_zh: 第二条件句（与现在事实相反）：If + 过去式，would + 动词原形。

items.prompt_en: This book ___ by millions of people.
items.explanation_zh: 书是被读的：被动语态 has been read。

items.prompt_en: I'm not used to ___ up so early.
items.explanation_zh: be used to 里的 to 是介词，后面接名词或动词-ing。

items.sentence_en: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
items.translation_zh: 那个车被偷了的人报了警。
items.explanation_zh: whose 表示“……的”，引导定语从句：the man whose car …

items.prompt_en: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
items.explanation_zh: 到达之前电影已经开始：过去完成时 had started。

items.prompt_en: She suggested ___ a taxi.
items.explanation_zh: suggest 后面接动名词：suggest doing。

items.prompt_en: If I ___ harder at school, I would have a better job now.
items.explanation_zh: 过去没做（had studied）→ 现在的结果（would have）：混合条件句。

items.prompt_en: I wish I ___ that email yesterday.
items.explanation_zh: 对过去的事表示后悔：wish + 过去完成时。

items.prompt_en: The project, ___ was finished last week, cost twice as much as planned.
items.explanation_zh: 逗号隔开的非限制性定语从句用 which，不用 that。

items.prompt_en: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
items.explanation_zh: Not only 放句首时，后面部分倒装：Not only was he late ...

items.prompt_en: It's high time we ___ a decision.
items.explanation_zh: It's (high) time + 主语 + 过去式：表示“早该……了”。

items.prompt_en: Had I known about the traffic, I ___ earlier.
items.explanation_zh: Had I known = If I had known（第三条件句倒装），结果部分用 would have done。

items.prompt_en: Under no circumstances ___ left unlocked.
items.explanation_zh: 否定词组 Under no circumstances 放句首时要倒装：should the door be …

items.sentence_en: ___ it not been for your help, we would have failed.
items.translation_zh: 要不是你的帮助，我们就失败了。
items.explanation_zh: Had it not been for … = If it had not been for …，省略 if 后倒装。

items.prompt_en: Little ___ that the decision would change her life.
items.explanation_zh: 否定意义的 Little 放句首时倒装：Little did she know ...

items.prompt_en: So ___ the response that the organisers had to add extra dates.
items.explanation_zh: So + 形容词 + be + 主语 + that ...：强调式倒装。

items.prompt_en: I'd rather you ___ mention this to anyone.
items.explanation_zh: would rather + 主语 + 过去式：表示希望别人（现在或将来）做 / 不做某事。

items.prompt_en: Were the government ___ raise taxes, there would be protests.
items.explanation_zh: Were + 主语 + to do = If + 主语 + were to do，表示假设的将来情况。

items.prompt_en: ___ as it may seem, the plan actually worked.
items.explanation_zh: 形容词 + as + 主语 + may seem：让步倒装，意为“虽然看起来……”。

items.passage_en: Hi! I'm Lily. I'm eight. I have a red bike and a black cat.
items.prompt_zh: Lily 的自行车是什么颜色？
items.explanation_zh: I have a red bike：红色的自行车。猫是黑色的。

items.passage_en:
BOOKSHOP
Open: 9:00 – 17:00
Closed on Sundays
items.explanation_zh: Open 9:00 – 17:00：下午 5 点关门；周日不开门。

items.passage_en: This is my family. My dad is tall. My mum has long hair. I have one brother. His name is Sam.
items.explanation_zh: I have one brother：一个兄弟，叫 Sam。

items.passage_en:
CAFÉ
Tea ¥10
Coffee ¥15
Cake ¥12
items.explanation_zh: Coffee ¥15。茶 ¥10，蛋糕 ¥12。

items.passage_en:
Hi Tom,
Sorry, I can't come to the cinema on Saturday. I have to work. Can we go on Sunday afternoon?
Anna
items.prompt_zh: Anna 为什么周六不能去看电影？
items.explanation_zh: I have to work：她要上班。

items.passage_en:
SWIMMING POOL
Adults: ¥40
Children under 12: ¥20
Closed on Mondays
items.prompt_zh: 一个 10 岁的孩子周二来游泳，要付多少钱？
items.explanation_zh: 10 岁不满 12 岁，按儿童价 ¥20；周二开放。

items.passage_en:
Dear Grandma,
I'm at the beach with Mum and Dad. The weather is hot and sunny. Every morning we swim in the sea, and in the afternoon we sleep. See you next week!
Love, Ben
items.explanation_zh: in the afternoon we sleep：下午睡觉；上午游泳。

items.passage_en:
NOTICE
The library is closed today because of a broken window. It will open again tomorrow at 9:00.
items.prompt_zh: 图书馆今天为什么关门？
items.explanation_zh: because of a broken window：因为窗户坏了。

items.passage_en: Last month Mark moved from a small town to London. At first he felt lonely because he didn't know anyone. Then he joined a running club, and now he has lots of friends.
items.prompt_zh: Mark 是怎么交到朋友的？
items.explanation_zh: Then he joined a running club, and now he has lots of friends。

items.passage_en: Please note: today the 8:15 train to Oxford will leave from platform 4 instead of platform 2.
items.explanation_zh: instead of platform 2：从 2 号站台改到 4 号站台。

items.passage_en: Sara wanted to learn the guitar, but lessons were too expensive. So she watched free videos online and practised for twenty minutes every evening. After six months, she played her first song at a friend's party.
options: 看免费的网上视频自学
items.explanation_zh: lessons were too expensive，所以她 watched free videos online。

items.passage_en: Dear customer, your order has been sent. Because of the holiday, delivery may take two extra days. If you are not at home, the driver will leave the parcel with a neighbour.
items.explanation_zh: the driver will leave the parcel with a neighbour：交给邻居。

items.passage_en: Many people believe that working from home makes employees less productive. However, a recent study found the opposite: people who worked from home completed more tasks, although they also reported feeling more isolated.
options: 在家工作完成的任务更多，但更孤独
items.explanation_zh: found the opposite（与大家的看法相反）：completed more tasks，although ... more isolated。

items.passage_en: The hotel was in a great location, but the room was much smaller than the photos suggested, and the Wi-Fi kept dropping. For the price, I expected more.
items.prompt_zh: 总体来说，作者对酒店的感受是：
items.explanation_zh: 虽然位置好，但房间小、网络差，For the price, I expected more：有点失望。

items.passage_en: When the town replaced its car park with a small square and some trees, local shop owners were worried they would lose customers. A year later, most of them say business has actually improved, because more people now stop and walk around instead of just driving through.
items.prompt_zh: 一年后，大多数店主怎么说？
items.explanation_zh: business has actually improved：actually 表示和原先的担心相反。

items.passage_en: I'd recommend the course to anyone who is completely new to photography. If you already know the basics, though, you might find the first few weeks a little slow.
items.prompt_zh: 作者认为这门课最适合谁？
options: 已经掌握基础、想提高的人
items.explanation_zh: recommend … to anyone who is completely new；已经懂基础的人会觉得前几周有点慢。

items.passage_en: Although electric scooters are often promoted as a green alternative to cars, critics point out that many scooter trips replace walking or public transport rather than driving. In that case, the environmental benefit largely disappears.
options: 滑板车替代的多是步行和公交，环保效果有限
滑板车比汽车污染更大
items.explanation_zh: replace walking or public transport rather than driving → the environmental benefit largely disappears。

items.passage_en: The new manager's approach could hardly have been more different from her predecessor's: where he made decisions alone and announced them by email, she insists on discussing every major change with the team first.
options: 自己决定后发邮件通知
重大变化先和团队商量
items.explanation_zh: could hardly have been more different = 截然不同；she insists on discussing every major change with the team first。

items.passage_en: Supporters of the four-day working week argue that it boosts morale without reducing output. Trials have been encouraging, but most involved office-based companies that volunteered to take part, so it remains unclear whether the results would hold in sectors such as healthcare or manufacturing.
items.prompt_zh: 作者对试点结果的看法是：
options: 已经证明四天工作制适用于所有行业
结果令人鼓舞，但能否推广到其他行业还不清楚
items.explanation_zh: encouraging, but … it remains unclear whether the results would hold in sectors such as healthcare。

items.passage_en: Rather than banning phones outright, the school asked students to keep them in their bags during lessons. Teachers report fewer distractions, although some parents feel the rule doesn't go far enough.
items.explanation_zh: doesn't go far enough = 做得还不够，即希望更严格（比如完全禁止）。

items.passage_en: The council's claim that the new bypass will 'ease congestion' rests on the assumption that traffic levels will remain stable. Yet decades of research suggest that new roads tend to generate additional traffic, eventually filling the extra capacity.
items.prompt_zh: 作者对市政府的说法持什么态度？
options: 认为它建立在一个可疑的假设上
认为研究不足、无法判断
items.explanation_zh: rests on the assumption ... Yet decades of research suggest ...：作者用研究质疑这个假设。

items.passage_en: While the author acknowledges that remote learning widened access for some students, she argues that its benefits have been overstated, largely because the studies most often cited relied on self-reported data from highly motivated volunteers.
items.prompt_zh: 作者为什么认为远程学习的好处被高估了？
options: 远程学习没有扩大受教育机会
常被引用的研究在样本和数据来源上有偏差
学生普遍不喜欢远程学习
items.explanation_zh: relied on self-reported data from highly motivated volunteers：自我报告的数据、积极性很高的志愿者，样本有偏差。作者承认它扩大了部分学生的机会。

items.passage_en: The museum's decision to return the statues has been hailed as a moral victory, yet it is worth noting that it came only after years of legal pressure and a sharp decline in visitor numbers. Generosity, in this case, seems to have been the last resort rather than the first instinct.
items.prompt_zh: 作者暗示博物馆归还雕像是因为：
options: 完全出于道德上的考虑
迫于法律压力和参观人数下降，不得已而为之
items.explanation_zh: the last resort rather than the first instinct：是最后的办法，而不是本能的选择。

items.passage_en: Critics of the policy are right that it will be costly in the short term. What they tend to overlook, however, is the far greater cost of doing nothing: every year of delay makes the eventual adjustment more abrupt and more painful.
options: 认为这项政策没有任何代价
承认短期代价，但认为不作为的代价更大
items.explanation_zh: Critics … are right that …（让步），however … the far greater cost of doing nothing（真正的观点）。

items.passage_en: To call the novel's ending 'happy' would be to miss the point entirely; the reunion the characters have longed for arrives only after everything that made it worth wanting has been lost.
options: 表面圆满，实则充满失落
items.explanation_zh: 团聚终于到来，但让它值得期待的一切都已失去：表面圆满，实际是失落。

items.passage_en: The CEO described the quarter as 'challenging but full of learning opportunities', which, given that profits fell by a third and two factories closed, was a masterpiece of understatement.
items.prompt_zh: 作者怎么看这位 CEO 的说法？
options: 带着讽刺指出他大大淡化了严重的问题
items.explanation_zh: a masterpiece of understatement（轻描淡写的“杰作”）是反讽：利润下降三分之一、两家工厂关闭，远不止“有挑战”。

items.passage_en: His memoir is admirably candid about his professional failures, which makes its near-total silence on his family life all the more conspicuous.
items.prompt_zh: 作者对这本回忆录的看法是：
options: 对事业失败很坦率，因此几乎不提家庭生活就格外显眼
完全回避了事业上的失败
items.explanation_zh: all the more conspicuous：正因为别处很坦率，对家庭的沉默才更引人注意。

items.passage_en: That the proposal survived the committee stage at all says less about its merits than about the committee's reluctance to be seen opposing anything with the word 'green' in its title.
items.prompt_zh: 作者认为提案能通过委员会审议，主要是因为：
options: 委员会不愿被人看作反对任何带“绿色”字样的东西
委员会成员都热心环保
items.explanation_zh: says less about its merits than about …：与其说说明提案好，不如说说明委员会怕被看作反对“绿色”。

items.audio_en: Seventeen.
items.prompt_zh: 听录音，选出你听到的数字。
items.explanation_zh: seven-TEEN：17。

items.audio_en: Good morning! How are you?
items.explanation_zh: Good morning! How are you? 是打招呼和问候。

items.audio_en: Blue.
items.prompt_zh: 听录音，选出你听到的颜色。
items.explanation_zh: blue = 蓝色。

items.audio_en: Goodbye! See you tomorrow.
items.explanation_zh: Goodbye / See you tomorrow：道别。

items.audio_en: The meeting is on Thursday at three o'clock.
items.explanation_zh: on Thursday at three o'clock：周四 3 点。

items.audio_en: Can I have a coffee, please? No sugar, thanks.
items.explanation_zh: a coffee ... No sugar：不加糖的咖啡。

items.audio_en: The shop opens at half past nine.
items.explanation_zh: half past nine = 九点半。

items.audio_en: I'd like two tickets for the film, please. One adult and one child.
options: 一张成人票和一张儿童票
items.explanation_zh: One adult and one child：一大一小。

items.audio_en: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible, and then I couldn't find a parking space.
options: 堵车，而且找不到停车位
items.explanation_zh: The traffic was terrible（堵车），couldn't find a parking space（找不到停车位）。

items.audio_en: Hi, I'd like to book a table for four people at half past seven, please.
items.explanation_zh: a table for four people at half past seven：7:30，4 位。

items.audio_en: I can't meet you on Friday because I'm visiting my parents. How about Saturday morning?
items.prompt_zh: 说话人建议什么时候见面？
items.explanation_zh: How about Saturday morning? 周五要去看父母。

items.audio_en: Take the second street on the left, and the post office is opposite the bank.
options: 第二条街右转，在银行旁边
第二条街左转，在银行对面
第一条街左转，在银行对面
items.explanation_zh: the second street on the left … opposite the bank：第二条街左转，银行对面。

items.audio_en: I used to hate public speaking, but after taking a course last year, I actually enjoy giving presentations now.
items.prompt_zh: 说话人现在对公开演讲的态度是：
items.explanation_zh: used to hate（以前讨厌），now ... enjoy（现在喜欢）。

items.audio_en: We're running a bit behind schedule, so let's skip the coffee break and finish the last two items first.
items.prompt_zh: 会议接下来会怎么安排？
options: 取消茶歇，先讨论最后两项
items.explanation_zh: skip the coffee break（跳过茶歇），finish the last two items first（先完成最后两项）。

items.audio_en: The flat itself is lovely, but it's a forty-minute bus ride to the office, so I'm still not sure whether to take it.
items.prompt_zh: 说话人还在犹豫，主要是因为：
items.explanation_zh: it's a forty-minute bus ride to the office：上班要坐四十分钟公交。

items.audio_en: Just a reminder that the deadline for the report has moved forward to Wednesday, not Friday as we said before.
items.explanation_zh: moved forward to Wednesday, not Friday：提前到了周三。

items.audio_en: I wouldn't say the presentation went badly, exactly, but I'd have liked a bit more time to prepare the figures.
items.prompt_zh: 说话人对这次演示的感受是：
options: 不算差，但希望有更多时间准备数据
items.explanation_zh: I wouldn't say ... went badly（不算差），but I'd have liked more time（希望有更多时间）。

items.audio_en: The train was supposed to leave at nine, but because of a signal failure it's now expected at nine forty, so you've got time for a coffee if you want.
items.prompt_zh: 火车现在预计几点出发？
items.explanation_zh: it's now expected at nine forty：现在预计九点四十。

items.audio_en: To be honest, the course was harder than I'd expected, but I'm glad I stuck with it, because it's made a real difference at work.
items.prompt_zh: 说话人对这门课的总体评价是：
options: 虽然难，但坚持下来很值得
items.explanation_zh: harder than I'd expected, but I'm glad I stuck with it：比预想的难，但庆幸坚持下来了。

items.audio_en: We were planning to launch in June, but given the feedback from the trial, we've decided to hold off until we've fixed the payment issues.
options: 试用反馈显示要先解决支付问题
items.explanation_zh: given the feedback … hold off until we've fixed the payment issues。

items.audio_en: Frankly, I'm not convinced the merger will deliver the savings they're promising, though I'd be happy to be proved wrong.
items.prompt_zh: 说话人对这次合并的看法是：
options: 持怀疑态度，但愿意被证明是错的
items.explanation_zh: I'm not convinced（不相信），though I'd be happy to be proved wrong（但希望自己错了）。

items.audio_en: Had the funding come through in March, we'd have finished the pilot by now; as it is, we're looking at the end of the year at the earliest.
items.prompt_zh: 试点项目最早什么时候完成？
items.explanation_zh: Had the funding come through ...（要是三月拨款了，现在就做完了）是假设；as it is（实际上）最早年底。

items.audio_en: I take your point about the cost, but if we don't invest now, we'll only end up paying more to catch up later.
options: 认可成本问题，但认为现在不投资以后代价更大
同意因为成本太高而不投资
items.explanation_zh: I take your point …, but …：先承认对方的观点，再提出反对。

items.audio_en: The figures look impressive on paper, but they don't account for the customers we lost during the switchover.
options: 没有算上切换期间流失的客户，看起来比实际好
items.explanation_zh: look impressive on paper, but they don't account for …：纸面上好看，但漏算了流失的客户。

items.audio_en: Oh, wonderful. Another meeting that could have been an email. Just what I needed on a Friday afternoon.
items.explanation_zh: wonderful、Just what I needed 是反话；a meeting that could have been an email 说明他觉得这个会没必要开。

items.audio_en: It's not that I'm against the proposal as such; it's more that nobody seems to have thought through what happens if the projections turn out to be wrong.
items.prompt_zh: 说话人真正担心的是什么？
options: 他本来就反对这个提案
没人想过预测出错时怎么办
items.explanation_zh: It's not that ... it's more that ...：不是反对提案本身，而是没人考虑预测出错的后果。

items.audio_en: Well, that went about as smoothly as I expected, which is to say not at all.
options: 事情一点也不顺利，正如他所料
items.explanation_zh: which is to say not at all：反讽，他本来就预料会不顺利。

items.audio_en: I'm all for ambition, but promising a full redesign in a fortnight strikes me as setting the team up to fail.
options: 两周内完成全面改版不现实，等于让团队注定失败
items.explanation_zh: I'm all for ambition, but …：先表示支持，再指出两周（a fortnight）全面改版不现实。
